run_turk_pipeline_tool_D: run the full Mechanical Turk annotation pipeline for tool 1D including preprocessing, HIT creation, result collection, collation, and postprocessing
create_turk_job: create Mechanical Turk HITs from a CSV input file using an XML question template and tool number
get_hits_result: poll the MTurk API for completed HIT assignments and write results to a CSV output file
construct_turk_input_csv: construct a CSV input file from newline-separated commands in an input text file for a given tool number
collate_and_postprocess_turk_outputs: collate Turk output data with job specs and postprocess results into well-formed action dictionaries
